production.note: US model years. First: the release is for the '2022 LEXUS IS 500 F SPORT PERFORMANCE', 'expected to arrive in dealerships later this Fall' (2021). Last: Lexus announced the '2025 Lexus IS 500 Ultimate Edition', 'Limited to 500 units in North America' (19 May 2025) (lexus-us-2025-is500-ultimate), and Lexus says the '2026 IS will only be offered as 350 model with two available grades: F SPORT Design and F SPORT' (9 September 2025) (lexus-us-2026-is-release).

configuration.note: '472-horsepower naturally aspirated 5.0-liter V8 engine'; engine code '5.0-liter 2UR-GSE V8 engine' (lexus-us-2025-is500-ultimate)

displacementL.note: '5.0-liter V8'. No opened IS 500 page prints the cc figure.

fuel.note: Inferred from Lexus's description of a naturally aspirated V8; no hybrid system.

transmission.note: 'eight-speed Sport Direct Shift automatic transmission with lockup torque converter'

powerHp.note: 2022 model year. Quote: "The IS 500 has a maximum output of 472 hp at 7,100 rpm and 395 lb.-ft. of peak torque at 4,800 rpm." Unchanged for 2025: '472 hp and 395-lb.-ft. of torque' (lexus-us-2025-is500-ultimate).

weightLb.note: 2022 model year; one configuration (8-speed automatic, RWD). Quote: "Despite the drastically more powerful engine, the vehicle tips the scales at 3,891 pounds, gaining only 143 pounds of additional curb weight over the standard IS 350 F SPORT." Lexus's 10 September 2021 release also gives 3,891 pounds (lexus-us-2022-is500-new-breed).
